stem:
Ritu deposits $\mathrm{Rs}\,5000$ at $10\%$ per year simple interest for 3 years.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Each year the interest is $10\%$ of the amount after adding the previous year's interest.
The interest for 3 years is $10\%$ of $\mathrm{Rs}\,5000$ once only.
Each year the interest is $10\%$ of the same principal $\mathrm{Rs}\,5000$.
Simple interest applies only in the first year, then the rate becomes zero.

teacher.key_rationale: Simple interest keeps the principal fixed, so each year uses $10\%$ of $\mathrm{Rs}\,5000$. Compounding on the updated amount, charging the rate only once for three years, or stopping after year one are incorrect.
